articles.title: China’s Tsingtao Brewery Sets its Sights on Irish Whiskey With Blockbuster Partnership
articles.summary: Great Northern Distillery has inked an agreement with Tsingtao Brewery to begin producing Irish whiskey for the Chinese market. The partnership will see Ireland’s second-largest distiller join forces with China’s second-largest brewer to bet big on the country’s lucrative foreign spirits category.
